summary: South Plains Financial filed an 8-K reporting the mutual termination of a 2019 Board Representation Agreement with Henry TAW LP, as the shareholder's ownership dropped from ~16% to under 10%. No financial terms, premium, or price were involved. The agreement gave the shareholder the right to nominate one board member; that director remains on the board. The filing describes a routine governance adjustment as the company's shareholder base became more widely held. There is no acquisition, divestiture, restructuring, or other special situation. This is a routine governance-related current report.
